causal_observation.observation: EVENT flow was strongly SELL-dominant while REST flow was BUY-dominant. FULL dominance remained near balance. OI contracted materially. Downside price progress inside the selected range remained limited relative to the observed SELL-side event dominance.
causal_observation.working_hypothesis: SELL-side event aggression during OI contraction may represent closing/pressure that is being accepted without proportional downside continuation.

outcome.definition: For the descriptive SELL-side evaluation only: MFE is the largest end-price-to-future-low excursion and MAE is the largest future-high-to-end-price excursion. Outcome is stored separately and is not used to classify causal state.

notes: Benchmark evidence only; opposite-side and control cases are required. Causal observation and future outcome are intentionally separate. No claim is made about whales, retail, confirmed absorption, short accumulation, market maker activity, or a bullish signal.
